run_codegen_training: run the codegen model training loop with causal LM, MLM, MT, and auto-encoder steps via CLI
build_argparse_parser: build an argparse parser with 100+ arguments for codegen model training configuration including model, data, and training params
run_encoder_only_training: run a single encoder-only transformer model training with configurable embedding dimensions, layers, and heads
run_multitask_training: run multi-task training combining CLM, MLM, machine translation, back-translation, deobfuscation, and self-training steps
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only mode to compute BLEU, computation correctness, and other metrics without training
